review_candidates.title: Live Stream Producer
review_candidates.description: The region's biggest creators go live from gaming setups, football pitches, launch events and the street, often with a day's notice. We need the person who builds the setup, keeps every stream live and proves what it delivered. Two non-negotiables: you use AI every single day, and you know exactly who 8FLAMEZ is before you apply. If either one is missing, this role is not for you. WHO ARE WE? For 4+ years, 8FLAMEZ has built the commercial engine behind the Middle East's most influential creators, with a roster that reaches 1B+ combined. Today we are the region's only creator-led venture group. We are due to launch 4 to 5 ventures this year across SaaS, consumer packaged goods (CPG) and a healthy beverage brand, with a new venture launching publicly every 1 to 2 months. Three founders, one mandate: AboFlah , the region's biggest creator with 70M+ followers and two Guinness World Records; Saad Sarwar , a 2x exited founder; and Eyad Siyam , who leads content and creators. Live is where our creators are at their biggest. AboFlah's 10-day charity livestream raised more than USD 10 million and set two Guinness World Records. Today he and Bilal Fadili, the leading MENA voice on Twitch, go live across gaming, football, events and IRL, with brand partners built into the biggest streams. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own every live stream we run, from first brief to final report: gaming, IRL, events, charity streams, venture launches and sponsored activations. Design, build and maintain our live setups in the studio and on the road: cameras, audio, lighting, encoders, scenes, overlays and backup connectivity, with the kit always ready to fly. Run the show live as technical producer: switching, audio, graphics, sponsor moments and talkback with the creator. Fix problems before chat notices them. Take IRL streams anywhere at short notice: backpack rigs, bonded cellular, mobile setups and a plan B for every venue and country. Pick up the camera when the moment calls for it, on the stream and behind the scenes, and flag the moments worth clipping. Deliver every sponsor segment exactly as contracted: overlays, reads, chat commands, giveaways and timings, with proof captured for each one. Report on every stream: peak and average viewers, watch time, chat, sponsor delivery and clips, plus what we change next time. GOT WHAT IT TAKES? You're borderline paranoid about dropped frames and dead air, and you live for the moment a stream peaks. You've produced live streams for creators, esports or live events, and can show VODs or clips of streams you ran yourself. Gaming and IRL, ideally both. You know OBS, Streamlabs or vMix inside out, plus Twitch, YouTube and TikTok Live, encoders, bitrates, audio routing and bonded cellular for IRL. You're highly capable behind a camera: on a tripod, on a gimbal or handheld on the move. You use AI every day for run sheets, troubleshooting, captions, clipping and reporting. You stay calm when something breaks live, and you fix it fast. You're discreet. You'll be in the room with creators and their brand partners, and you know what stays off stream. You're based in Dubai, with a valid passport and the freedom to travel worldwide at short notice. Fluent English is required and Arabic is a strong advantage. 🚀 WHAT WE OFFER Competitive salary + benefits. Work directly in AboFlah's world and alongside Bilal Fadili, on the biggest live moments in the region. Ownership of live production across 8FLAMEZ from day one. A role built to grow: into technical director, live content lead and main camera for every live experience we run. Travel across the region and the world with the creators, covered by 8FLAMEZ. Dubai, hybrid. ⚠️ BEFORE YOU APPLY We hire ruthlessly. The standard is the absolute best, and it starts with knowing exactly who you are applying to. Spend real time on 8flamez.co: our creators, our work, our founders. If you can't explain what 8FLAMEZ does and why this role matters to it, don't apply yet. Your first interview opens with one question: what does 8FLAMEZ do? Know the answer. 📩 HOW TO APPLY Use Easy Apply with links to your streams in your CV, or apply directly at 8flamez.co/careers. Send three live streams you produced, with a VOD or clip of each. For each one, tell us the setup, your role and how it performed. Tell us which AI tools you use every day. Then answer one question: you're 40 minutes into a sponsored IRL stream abroad and the connection drops. What do you do in the next 60 seconds? Your streams are the application, so skip the cover letter.

Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, and maintain AWS infrastructure for research, backtesting, and production workloads. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for C++ and Python applications to ensure rapid and reliable delivery. Automate provisioning and monitoring for colocation environments , including server deployments and low-latency system tuning. Implement and enforce cybersecurity best practices across both on-prem and cloud systems. Manage LDAP/Active Directory for centralized authentication and fine-grained access control. Required Qualifications 2+ years of DevOps/SRE experience , ideally in finance, trading, or other high-performance domains. Practical experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions). Experience managing LDAP/Active Directory environments. Knowledge of cybersecurity practices — IAM, intrusion detection, encryption, vulnerability management. Proficiency in scripting with Python and Bash/Shell . Familiarity with C++ build systems (CMake, Bazel, Make) and Python packaging/deployment. Nice to Have Exposure to low-latency trading infrastructure and exchange colocation. Knowledge of specialized NICs and time synchronization (ExaNIC, Solarflare, PTP). Containerization and orchestration experience (Docker, Kubernetes). AWS or security certifications (AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Security+). What We Offer Opportunity to work on cutting-edge HFT infrastructure in a fast-paced environment. Hands-on exposure to colocated systems and ultra-low latency technology . Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses . A collaborative, research-driven culture with strong emphasis on innovation and continuous learning .

review_candidates.title: Senior IT OT Engineer
review_candidates.description: APM Terminals APM Terminals is seeking a highly skilled and business-oriented Senior IT/OT Engineer to lead the implementation, integration, operation, and continuous improvement of IT/OT technologies within the terminal environment. As a key member of the IT/OT team, you will act as a trusted technology partner to Terminal Operations, Engineering, Automation, and other business stakeholders , translating operational and business requirements into secure, resilient, scalable, and fit-for-purpose technology solutions. You will be responsible for managing the IT/OT technology landscape in alignment with APM Terminals and Maersk global standards , while ensuring that solutions meet terminal-specific operational requirements. You will proactively leverage best practices and proven solutions from other terminals, Hubs, and Regions to drive standardization, innovation, operational excellence, and value creation. The role combines technical leadership, business partnership, project delivery, service management, vendor management, continuous improvement, and people leadership . You will also contribute to cost leadership by identifying opportunities to optimize technology investments, simplify the IT/OT landscape, and improve operational efficiency. You will lead and support the Level 1 and Level 2 IT/OT engineering and shift teams , ensuring strong technical capability, operational discipline, effective collaboration, and high-quality service delivery. You will be responsible for: Manage and provide technical ownership of the IT/OT technology landscape within the assigned terminal domain. Act as a key technology partner to Operations, Engineering, Automation, and other stakeholders, understanding business priorities and translating them into effective IT/OT solutions. Lead the planning and execution of IT/OT upgrades, enhancements, lifecycle refreshes, and technology changes, ensuring alignment with global standards, change management practices, and IT service management processes. Ensure technology changes are implemented with minimum disruption to critical terminal operations and appropriate operational readiness and rollback plans. Own the IT/OT infrastructure lifecycle, proactively identifying obsolescence, capacity constraints, technology risks, and opportunities for modernization. Ensure the integrity, availability, resilience, security, and interoperability of the IT/OT landscape and its associated systems and subsystems. Ensure IT/OT infrastructure and technology solutions effectively support automation concepts, terminal processes, and port equipment requirements. Lead incident, problem, and root cause management, ensuring timely resolution of critical IT/OT issues and implementation of sustainable corrective and preventive actions within agreed SLAs. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve system reliability, operational efficiency, service quality, and user experience. Lead and support IT/OT projects from requirements definition and solution design through implementation, commissioning, transition, and stabilization. Provide the appropriate IT/OT technical input and support for QA, testing, commissioning, and operational acceptance activities. Ensure effective vendor and technology partner management, including performance management, technical governance, escalation, and service delivery. Identify and implement cost optimization and cost-saving opportunities, leveraging standardization, technology rationalization, best practices, and fit-for-purpose solutions. Promote agile ways of working, automation, innovation, and continuous improvement across the IT/OT organization. Lead, coach, and develop the L1/L2 IT/OT engineering and shift teams, ensuring the right technical capabilities, coverage, and performance. Facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration between Terminal IT/OT, Global Technology, Regional/HUB teams, Engineering, Automation, Operations, Cybersecurity, and external partners. Proactively assess technology risks, dependencies, and business impacts, escalating critical issues and providing clear recommendations to management. Ensure effective 24x7 IT/OT operational support for mission-critical terminal systems and infrastructure. What we are looking for: Proven experience as a Senior IT/OT Engineer, IT/OT Infrastructure Engineer, Industrial Technology Engineer, or equivalent within a complex operational or industrial environment. Strong understanding of IT/OT architecture, industrial networks, automation systems, PLC/controls, port equipment, Terminal Operating Systems, and related industrial infrastructure. Experience working with mission-critical IT/OT environments where availability, resilience, and operational continuity are key priorities. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex IT/OT infrastructure and system issues, including cross-domain incidents involving IT, OT, network, automation, and industrial systems. Strong understanding of IT service management, incident/problem management, change management, project management, risk management, and vendor management. Proven ability to translate business and operational requirements into technology solutions, balancing technical feasibility, business value, risk, and cost. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with Operations, Engineering, Automation, IT, Cybersecurity, vendors, and senior management. Demonstrated experience managing multiple activities, projects, priorities, and technical teams simultaneously. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to RCA, risk assessment, troubleshooting, and decision-making. Strong leadership capabilities, with proven ability to lead, coach, and develop technical engineering teams. Demonstrated commercial awareness and ability to identify technology optimization and cost-saving opportunities. Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration across cross-functional and multicultural teams. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical matters clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A strong continuous improvement and ownership mindset, with a focus on operational excellence, standardization, reliability, and business value. Ability to operate effectively in a 24x7 terminal environment and manage priorities during critical operational situations. Experience in port terminals, logistics, manufacturing, industrial automation, or other mission-critical operational environments is highly desirable. review_candidates.title: Senior Database Engineer PostgreSQL (all genders)
review_candidates.description: Über uns Die OPITZ CONSULTING Deutschland GmbH ist ein führender Partner der Digitalisierung. Als Digitale Service Manufaktur beraten wir und entwickeln Software mit über 400 Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Unsere Kunden: vom Mittelstand bis zum DAX-Konzern – gemeinsam auf dem Weg in die digitale Zukunft. Das was viele versprechen, halten wir: Unsere Wege sind kurz, die Hierarchien flach. Wir sind inhabergeführt, kennen uns noch beim Namen und sind füreinander da. Das machst du Als Senior Database Engineer PostgreSQL übernimmst du den Aufbau, Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung moderner Datenbankinfrastrukturen mit Fokus auf PostgreSQL. Du stellst einen stabilen, performanten und sicheren Datenbankbetrieb in komplexen Kundenumgebungen sicher – sowohl in der Cloud als auch On-Premises. Dabei agierst du als zentrale technische Ansprechperson für Architektur-, Migrations- und Transformationsprojekte. Architektur und Design: Du unterstützt bei Konzeption, Design und Weiterentwicklung von PostgreSQL-Datenbanklandschaften sowie hybriden Plattformen mit Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server oder MongoDB. Aufbau und Betrieb: Du installierst, konfigurierst und betreibst PostgreSQL-Datenbanksysteme in Cloud- und On-Premises-Umgebungen. Hochverfügbarkeit und Backup: Du konzipierst und implementierst Backup-, Recovery- und Disaster-Recovery-Strategien, z. B. mit pgBackRest, Barman oder EDB BART. Migration und Transformation: Du führst Cloud-Migrationen, Datenbank-Konsolidierungen und Technologie-Transitionen durch und begleitest strategische Transformationsprojekte. Performance und Monitoring: Du analysierst Performance, planst Kapazitäten und optimierst Datenbankumgebungen mit Monitoring-Tools wie pgwatch2, pganalyze, Grafana oder Checkmk. Automatisierung und Beratung: Du setzt Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, AWX oder Terraform um, arbeitest eng mit Applikations- und Cloud-Teams zusammen und berätst Kunden auch im Presales-Kontext. Das bringst du mit PostgreSQL Expertise: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in Installation, Administration und Konfiguration von PostgreSQL-Datenbanken inklusive Backup- und Recovery-Strategien. Tooling und Monitoring: Du arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie pgadmin4 sowie Monitoring-Lösungen wie pgwatch2, pganalyze, Grafana oder Checkmk. Automatisierung und Linux: Du hast Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Ansible, AWX oder Terraform, und bewegst dich sicher in Linux-Umgebungen. Hochverfügbarkeit und Tuning: Du kennst HA-Lösungen wie Streaming Replication, Patroni oder PgBouncer und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung im Performance-Tuning sowie sehr gute SQL-Kenntnisse mit. Cloud und Plattformen: Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Cloud-Umgebungen, Container-Technologien und Kubernetes im Datenbankkontext sowie mit Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server oder MongoDB. Kommunikation und Arbeitsweise: Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und Englisch, trittst souverän auf, arbeitest strukturiert im SLA- oder ITIL-orientierten Umfeld und bist bereit für Workshops oder punktuelle Vor-Ort-Einsätze. Unsere Benefits Arbeitszeit & Hybridmodell: Flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne Kernarbeitszeit und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Homeoffice-Anteil – für maximale Flexibilität, abgestimmt auf deine Projekte, Kundentermine und dein Team. Weiterbildung & OC|Academy: 12 Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr für Trainings, Konferenzen und Zertifizierungen. Zugang zur OC|Academy sowie Kostenübernahme für anerkannte IT-Zertifikate. Community & Netzwerk: Lerngruppen, Tech Sessions und Community Days für fachlichen Austausch mit erfahrenen IT-Consultants und Expert:innen. Teamkultur & Zusammenarbeit: Offene und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe, klare Kommunikation und kurze Entscheidungswege – in einem Umfeld, in dem du dich fachlich einbringen und aktiv mitgestalten kannst. Gesundheit & Vorsorge: 6 Monate volle Lohnfortzahlung im Krankheitsfall, aufgestockte betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie Zuschuss zu EGYM Wellpass. Mobilität: Firmenwagen mit Fokus auf E-Mobilität, bis zu 2 Jobfahrräder und Mobilitätszuschuss, zum Beispiel für das Deutschlandticket. Familie & Unterstützung: Kindergartenzuschuss, Geburten- und Heiratszuschuss sowie bis zu 4 zusätzliche bezahlte Kinderkranktage. Empfehlungen, Jubiläen & Benefits: Prämien für Mitarbeiterempfehlungen, Jubiläumszuwendungen sowie attraktive Mitarbeiterangebote über unser Corporate-Benefits-Programm.
